_source: SFWF Website Copy Deck v1.0, section 11. Copy verbatim.

hero.intro: Your courses live on one of two learning platforms. Pick yours below. One click and you’re home.

choosers.name: New platform, Soil Food Web School on Thinkific
choosers.programs: For courses bought after 15 March 2026, or accounts that have already moved.

choosers.name: Original platform
choosers.programs: For courses bought before 15 March 2026 whose accounts have not moved yet.

choosers.name: sMApp, the microscope tool
choosers.programs: Turns what you count through a microscope into biomass figures and a report. A separate free tool with its own account, not a course platform. Accounts are for enrolled students for now.

helpLine: Students are moving to the new platform in stages. You will get an email when your account moves. Unsure? Write to info@soilfoodweb.com.
source: The live login page at soilfoodweb.com, checked 11 September 2026. The split is by purchase date and migration status.
